description: Write userAccountControl-related restrictions (e.g. disable Kerberos preauth, set delegation flags).

telemetry.detail: userAccountControl / restriction attribute change under DS-change auditing.
A user account was changed - default-on, fires on UAC edits.
Disabling preauth (to enable AS-REP roast) or flipping delegation flags is a known abuse signal.

abuse_primitive: Clear DONT_REQ_PREAUTH for AS-REP roast, or set delegation flags for a follow-on attack.
notes: 4738 is default-on so a UAC change on a privileged account is visible even without DS-change auditing.
